scopeNote: Curated, extensible high-level research inventory: 34 products and role categories, not an exhaustive list, current order of battle, recognition guide, combat simulator or validated runtime pack. Public purpose is source-backed where indicated; silhouette and all gameRole mappings are original design proposals.

artPolicy.sourcePreservation: Reference links do not grant permission to copy photos, manufacturer logos or protected emblems.
artPolicy.variants: Microtile, detailed and hybrid artwork can share identical geometry, rules and authored turn mode.
artPolicy.enemyIdentity: Hostile actors must be explicitly authored as invading military operators or fictional military machines. Nationality, language, civilian occupation or clothing alone never sets hostility.

evidencePolicy: Sources are primary manufacturer, state exporter or government pages. Official-search-extract means the web tool supplied indexed text; it is not a complete page, video or photo inspection. Government and manufacturer reports are attributed reports, not independent performance verification. Undated pages are not dated from search crawl timestamps. Unknown operator lists are empty.
